sentences.japanese: 空港まで迎えの車を出すように手配した。
sentences.english: I arranged for a car to meet you at the airport.

sentences.japanese: 空港へあなたを迎えに行けたのに。
sentences.english: I could've met you at the airport.

sentences.japanese: 空港へ迎えに行ってあげることもできたんだけど。
sentences.english: I could've met you at the airport.

sentences.japanese: 家族を空港に迎えに行かなくては。
sentences.english: I have to go to the airport to meet my family.

sentences.japanese: 空港に５時に迎えに来てください。
sentences.english: Please pick me up at the airport at five.
